title: Comments explain why, not what; record rejected alternatives
context: Codebase needed principle for comment value and what makes them worth maintaining.
decision: Every module opens with doc comment stating what it is *for* and which seam it sits on. Record the alternative rejected and why. Document what is deliberately absent. Explain non-obvious mechanics at point of use.
consequences: Comments have high value only when explaining reasoning. Stops relitigating decisions annually. Comment concentration capped at half file or 20 unbroken lines via scripts/check-comments.mjs. Long-form headers distributed onto items, tightened, then moved to docs/design-notes/ verbatim.
